notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tormod's Crypt ability, exiling target player's graveyard.
Repeat.
